findings.title: Absence of semantic <main> or <article> landmark tags (div soup)
findings.evidence: Document contains 0 <main> and 0 <article> landmarks. Core content is wrapped entirely in generic <div> containers.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap the primary textual substance in a semantic <main> landmark container.
suggested_action.rationale: Semantic HTML allows AI parsers to instantly separate substantive content from boilerplate navigation bars, cookie banners, and footers.

findings.title: Complex inline SVG data charts lack <title> or <desc> accessible metadata
findings.evidence: Found 1 complex SVG graphics (>= 5 data nodes) with zero <title>, <desc>, or aria-label attributes.

suggested_action.summary: Include <title> and <desc> tags inside complex SVG visualizations to describe their underlying data.
suggested_action.rationale: Screen readers and multimodal AI extractors rely on SVG title and description tags to extract facts from vector graphs.
suggested_action.code_fix_example:
<svg role="img" aria-labelledby="svg-title svg-desc">
  <title id="svg-title">Annual Growth Chart</title>
  <desc id="svg-desc">Graph showing 140% year-over-year revenue expansion in enterprise tier</desc>
  ...
</svg>

findings.title: Missing primary <h1> heading tag
findings.evidence: Document contains 0 <h1> heading tags. AI models rely on H1 to identify the core topic and entity of the page.

suggested_action.summary: Introduce a single, descriptive <h1> tag encapsulating the primary entity and value proposition.
suggested_action.rationale: Without an H1, AI document parsers struggle to establish the primary subject matter of the document, reducing citation confidence.
suggested_action.code_fix_example: Acme Cloud Platform: Automated Enterprise Workflow Orchestration

findings.title: Critical facts and diagrams trapped in images with missing or low-quality alt text
findings.evidence: Audited 3 informational images; 3/3 (100.0%) have defective alt attributes: 3 images completely lack alt attributes.

suggested_action.summary: Provide descriptive, factual alt text conveying the underlying information for all diagrams, charts, and product images.
suggested_action.rationale: Multimodal and text-only AI models cannot parse data graphs, workflows, or tier matrices stored in raster images without descriptive alt text.

findings.title: Broken heading hierarchy with skipped outline levels
findings.evidence: Detected 2 instances where headings skip outline levels: Document root -> <h3> ('Download'); <h1> ('Python 3.14.7 documentati') -> <h3> ('Download').

suggested_action.summary: Restructure headings to follow a strict sequential hierarchy (H1 -> H2 -> H3) without skipping levels.
suggested_action.rationale: AI RAG pipelines build hierarchical chunk trees from headings. Skipping levels causes subtopics to be misattributed to incorrect parent topics.

findings.title: Client-side JS hydration trap detected (empty SPA body shell)
findings.evidence: Target page contains only 13 extractable words in raw HTML (Payload: 645 bytes). Detected architecture: Client JavaScript Application Shell. Noscript fallback status: none.

suggested_action.summary: Implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or Static Site Generation (SSG) so raw HTML contains full text content.
suggested_action.rationale: AI crawlers like GPTBot and search indexing engines frequently fetch raw HTML without executing client-side JavaScript bundles. An empty body shell renders the brand completely invisible to AI assistants.
suggested_action.code_fix_example:
// Next.js: Ensure server components are default (avoid 'use client' on root layout)
